title: Daddy's Home
about: A mild radio exec tries to win over his stepkids when their cool, motorbike-riding real dad comes home.

    To StartBrad's rainbow rice paper rollsGriff moves in and stays for dinner. Vermicelli, carrot, capsicum and cucumber rollsHow to make it100g rice vermicelli1 carrot1 red capsicum1 continental cucumber1 avocado1 bunch mint12 rice paper sheets3 tbsp peanut butter2 tbsp hoisin sauce1 lime3 tbsp waterSoak the rice vermicelli in boiling water 5 minutes, drain and cool.Cut the carrot, the red capsicum and the cucumber into thin strips and slice the avocado.Dip a rice paper sheet in warm water for 10 seconds, lay flat and add the vegetables, noodles and mint, then roll up tightly.Repeat until all the rolls are made.Whisk the peanut butter, the hoisin, the lime juice and the warm water for dipping.Dusty's cool dad nachosCorn chips, spiced beef, cheese. Tumor grows on you.How to make it400g beef mince1 sachet taco seasoning300g corn chips200g tasty cheese1 jar tomato salsa150g sour creamBrown the beef mince with taco seasoning.Spread the corn chips on a tray, top with the beef and the grated cheese and bake at 200°C for 10 minutes.Finish with salsa and the sour cream.MainsBackyard dad-off smash burgersBrad and Dusty, co-dads at one grill. Smashed beef patties, cheese, onion, picklesHow to make it800g beef mince2 brown onions20g butter4 tbsp mayonnaisetomato sauce, to tastemustard, to taste1 jar dill pickles8 cheese slices4 potato bunsSlowly cook the sliced onions in butter for 15 minutes until golden.Mix the mayonnaise, the tomato sauce, the mustard and the chopped pickles.Roll the beef mince into balls.On a very hot barbecue plate, smash each flat, season and cook 2 minutes.Flip, add a cheese slice and cook 1 minute.Toast the potato buns, spread with sauce and stack the patties each with onion and pickles.Brad's grilled corn saladCharred corn, tomato, avocado, lime and coriander. Brad made it, of courseHow to make it4 corn cobs1 tbsp olive oil250g cherry tomatoes, halved2 avocados, diced1/2 red onion, finely sliced1 small bunch coriander2 limesRub the corn with oil and salt and grill, turning, until charred in spots.Cut the kernels off the cobs once cool enough to hold.Toss with the tomatoes, onion, avocado, chopped coriander, lime juice and salt.Something SweetDaddy-daughter dance cupcakesJam-filled vanilla cupcakes, pink buttercream. Megan picks Dusty.How to make it325g butter150g caster sugar2 eggsvanilla extract, to taste200g self-raising flour150ml milk120g raspberry jam400g icing sugarpink food colouring, to tastesprinkles, to taste12 cupcake casesHeat the oven to 175°C.Beat the butter and the caster sugar, add the eggs and the vanilla, then the self-raising flour and the milk.Divide between the paper cases and bake 18 minutes.Cool.Cut a small cone from the top of each, fill with raspberry jam and replace.Beat the butter with the icing sugar, the milk and pink colouring and pipe on top.Finish with sprinkles.To DrinkSmooth jazz strawberry basil lemonadeFor Brad's $18,000 Lakers seats. Strawberry basil syrup, lemon and soda over iceHow to make it100g caster sugar250g strawberries1 bunch basil5 lemons800ml soda water4 cups iceSimmer the caster sugar, the water and the sliced strawberries for 5 minutes.Take off the heat, add a handful of basil and steep 15 minutes, then strain and chill.Squeeze the lemons for the juice.Fill a jug with ice, add the syrup, lemon juice and the cold soda water and stir.Pour into glasses with sliced strawberries and a basil leaf.
